verdict.rationale: llamafile is a single-file local LLM runtime and inference server that offers a CLI, a chat Web UI and an HTTP API. An integrated document-editing workspace with agent drafting and automatic saving belongs to a different product category, a productivity or editor app. Nothing in the evidence shows llamafile ships any document workspace, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
